tasks.short: Develop and present health education and promotion programs

steps.what: Read the community need and the audience on the program record
State the aim, the duration, and three messages for this audience
Develop a session outline from the stated training messages
Check the outline copies the three messages and adds no advice
Present health education and promotion programs at workshops, conferences, and school presentations

tasks.design: She states the audience, the duration, and three messages. A draft in the {DOCS} lays those fields into a session outline and does not add health advice. She checks that nothing was added, then presents the workshop, conference, or school session herself. The outline is not filed again.
tasks.previous_blocker: The session text was written out by hand from aims she had not yet stated as fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Aim, audience, duration, and three messages are fields, so a layout can copy only those fields.
tasks.still_hard: Whether those messages are right for that school or neighbourhood, and giving the session.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what this audience must hear and what must not be promised, then presents it.
tasks.altitude: She still sets the messages and presents. She no longer retypes an outline from aims she has already stated.

reach.learn: Which three messages were cleared for this audience

evidence.claim: The digest's note tools record social-work intakes and visits. They are not a health-education session writer. This outline only copies the aim, audience, duration, and three messages she stated.
Checks of AI notes in social work found invented content, including suicidal ideation.

assumptions: The community need and the audience come from the assessment and the goal-setting work. This task does not run that assessment again. If the audience or a message is blank, no outline is produced.
She presents in the room. No pack is emailed to the school, so there is no external send and no second save of the outline.
A rejected outline is corrected inside the check. That time is already in the check step. No separate upkeep is counted.
unknowns: Whether this employer requires another person to clear health claims before a school session. That clearance is not in these shares.
research_questions: How often is a session a short talk with three messages, and how often is it a long workshop she still writes by hand?

already_counted.description: Check that the outline copies only the three messages she stated

incremental.description: No later queue. A bad copy is fixed inside the check before she presents.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month of one short school talk, where the outline is a few lines, saves less than a month of several workshops. The high end still leaves the presentation and the choice of messages untouched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set community health goals with specialists and civic groups

steps.what: Read the last goals and the services named for this community
Collaborate with health specialists and civic groups to determine community health needs
Develop goals for meeting needs with the specialists and civic groups

tasks.design: She reads the last goals in the {DOCS}, then sits with health specialists and civic groups. They determine needs and which services exist, and they agree the goals in the room. Nothing is drafted afterwards, and the goals are not filed by a machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Needs and service gaps are settled with people who are not on one system.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the meeting is shorter. The goals stay a decision she makes with them.
tasks.still_hard: Who is missing from the room, and which goal the group will stand behind.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the disagreement and commits the group to a goal.
tasks.altitude: The collaboration stays the week. No goal text is produced for her.

reach.task: State which services the group can offer

evidence.claim: Agreeing community goals with specialists and civic groups is the meeting itself. The digest does not show a filing step for that goal note, so none is counted.

assumptions: Service availability is stated by the specialists and civic groups in the meeting. This task does not re-key a service map from another system.
If a written goal list is later sent to a civic group, that send is a different action and is not in these shares.
No upkeep is counted because no tool is added.
unknowns: Whether the employer already keeps a service directory this role must update after each meeting.
research_questions: Do the agreed goals leave the room only as her memory, or as a note another team plans from?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The meeting that sets the goals stays as it is. No draft and no filing are counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run a health needs assessment or public health survey

steps.what: Read the population frame agreed for this health needs assessment
State the closed questions and options for the health needs assessments
Develop the survey form from the closed questions she stated
Check the form asks only the questions she stated for the surveys
Conduct health needs assessments and other public health surveys with respondents
Count the closed answers for each stated option
Check each total matches a stated option and a blank is not an answer
Write the accepted needs tally into the program record

tasks.design: She states closed questions and options. A form in the {DOCS} copies only those fields. After she conducts the survey, closed answers are counted in the survey store. She checks that a blank is not treated as an answer. Only that accepted tally is written once to the program record in {OTHER}, which planners use. She does not type the totals herself, and a rejected tally is not written.
tasks.previous_blocker: Closed answers were counted by hand, and the same totals were typed again into the program record.
tasks.enabler_now: Options she stated are on the form, so the count and the single program-record write use those codes.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the questions measure the need, and sitting with people who will not use a form.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the questions and rejects a total that treats a blank as an answer.
tasks.altitude: She still chooses the questions and conducts the assessment. She no longer tallies closed options by hand or types those totals a second time.

reach.task: Use the accepted tally when choosing a program
reach.learn: Which option totals were accepted and which blanks were left out

evidence.claim: Counting closed options and writing those totals once into the program record is clerical work this assessment already includes. The form copies her questions and does not write new health advice. Free text is not counted.
Health data is a special category of personal data.
Checks of AI notes in social work found invented content, including suicidal ideation.

assumptions: The population frame comes from the goal-setting work. If it is blank, she states it in the question step and this task does not reopen that meeting.
Respondents mark closed options during the conduct step. She does not re-key those marks. A free-text reply is left out of the count.

The program record is where this assessment's accepted totals are kept today for the planner. The write stores only the accepted tally. She does not also type it, and she does not approve a save of a note she wrote.
A change to a question or a total voids the acceptance. Nothing is written until she checks that version. Unreadable replies are dropped inside the check, so no later queue is counted.
The survey store is the system of record for answers. No parallel workbook is kept.
unknowns: What share of assessments are closed questions, and what share are interviews that stay manual.
Whether the program record is allowed to hold this survey under the employer's health-data rules.
research_questions: Which totals does the planner open later, and which write-ups are prose she still keeps herself?

already_counted.description: Check the form asks only the questions she stated
Check that a blank is not counted as an answer

incremental.description: No later remapping queue. Bad codes are dropped inside the tally check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A year when most assessments are interviews saves only the few closed forms she fields. The high end is a year of closed surveys whose totals are written once. Interviews and question-setting stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise staff implementing the health program

steps.what: Read the health program objectives for this period
Supervise professional and technical staff in implementing health programs, objectives, and goals
Decide what the staff should change in this period's health program

tasks.design: She reads the objectives and supervises professional and technical staff in the room while they implement the health program. The conversation is not recorded. No supervision note is drafted or filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision is a judgement of how a person is running a session.
tasks.enabler_now: No recording and no staff score are added. The supervision stays.
tasks.still_hard: Noticing a weak session and deciding what that person should change.
tasks.human_edge: She watches the work and corrects it with the person there.
tasks.altitude: The week of supervision stays. She does not keep a machine note of it.

reach.learn: What she asked them to change this week

evidence.claim: Watching staff run a health program is in-person supervision. The digest does not show a filing step for that supervision, so none is counted.
Recording staff conversations needs works-council consent.

assumptions: The Dutch works-council rule in the digest is why this design does not record the supervision talk. No staff-performance view is built.
A written personnel note, if the employer requires one, is not established as this task and is not counted.
No upkeep is counted because no tool is added.
unknowns: Whether a written supervision note is required in the personnel file at this employer.
research_questions: Is any note of the supervision already required, and who else reads it?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so there is no upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Supervision in the room stays as it is. No recording and no filing are counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week of presenting, meeting civic groups, conducting assessments, and supervising stays. She no longer retypes a session outline from messages she has already stated, and she no longer tallies closed survey options by hand or types those totals again.
reach: A school or community host receives the session she presents.
Health specialists and civic groups state which services exist and agree the goals.
A program planner uses the accepted survey tally.
Health program staff carry out the sessions she supervises.
skills_to_grow: State the three messages and the closed survey options before any outline or form is drafted.
Reject an outline that adds advice, and reject a tally that treats a blank as an answer.
Leave the presentation, the civic meeting, and the supervision in the room.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She still presents, meets the civic groups, conducts the assessment, and supervises in the room.
